slices.title: Theme-authority
slices.summary: Defined explicit URL over host preference over dark fallback as one tested theme authority.

slices.title: Dark-defaults
slices.summary: Development animation surfaces now default dark through the shared theme authority; explicit light state still round trips.

slices.title: Neutral-foreground-parity
slices.summary: Neutral equation paint now aliases Catalogue prose ink through one theme-responsive token; no prose-font or motion change.

slices.title: Development-dock-theming
slices.summary: Development dock and review capture now follow active light/dark surface tokens with narrow-layout and production-erasure evidence.

slices.title: Theme-evidence
slices.summary: Captured and inspected seven deterministic theme states; the requested development theme tranche is complete.

slices.title: Planner-ID-collision-guard
slices.summary: Function-wrap and homomorphic low-level IDs now coalesce under one data-declared planner identity with collision guards.

slices.title: Planner-exposure-metadata
slices.summary: Every operation now declares canonical planner exposure or alias status; exposed operations carry required concise source-owned summaries.

slices.title: Alias-normalization-protocol
slices.summary: A data-derived alias registry now normalizes legacy/provider IDs to canonical planner IDs and rejects unknown IDs without renderer leakage or central switches.

slices.title: Canonical-prompt-projection
slices.summary: Planner prompts now contain only canonical exposed operation names and concise summaries; aliases remain preserved for backend compatibility but are not model choices.

slices.title: Validator-canonicalization
slices.summary: Validation now canonicalizes registered aliases, records verified requested-to-canonical provenance, round trips accepted records, and rejects unknown or forged normalization.

slices.title: Typed-unsupported-result
slices.summary: Unsupported transformations now produce a validated typed abstention with exact adjacency coverage and never enter compilation; malformed abstentions remain repair-required.

slices.title: Governed-source-resolver
slices.summary: Governed source selection now requires one exact source/revision and verifies operation, entity, assumption, and contract availability before specialized truth validation.

slices.title: Balanced-operation-binding
slices.summary: All six balanced operations now require exact source/revision, adjacency endpoints, ordered correspondences, role mappings, assumptions, and operation pins before compilation.

slices.title: Change-of-base-binding
slices.summary: Change-of-base now uses shared governed source selection plus its existing branded verifier for exact bases, domains, endpoints, and ordered correspondences; accepted motion is unchanged.

slices.title: Narrow-planner-orchestration
slices.summary: Natural-language equation series now use one narrow orchestration seam: the model proposes canonical operations, registered binders attach exact verified evidence, and only then does the deterministic compiler run.

slices.title: Typed-repair-recovery
slices.summary: Planner, source-binding, and deterministic compilation failures now preserve the exact last valid candidate with typed repairs and an explicit recovery disposition; unsupported remains a non-compilation abstention.

slices.title: Reproducible-live-benchmark
slices.summary: Live benchmark evidence is now reproducible: model identity and repetition count are mandatory, prompts are fingerprinted deterministically, and every repetition records raw-response provenance and indexed results.

slices.title: Deterministic-boundary-gate
slices.summary: The deterministic planner boundary passes equation corpus, orchestration, reproducibility, architecture, ownership, and type gates; its live schema can express both proposals and typed abstentions without ambiguity.

slices.title: Pinned-live-benchmark
slices.summary: The pinned three-repeat live benchmark passed all 18 case-runs with exact supported selections, explicit unsupported abstentions, typed governed repairs, and zero authority attempts, mismatches, silent fallbacks, or provider errors.

slices.title: Planner-binding-closeout
slices.summary: Planner vocabulary and governed binding are durably closed with deterministic and pinned-live evidence; roadmap, strategy, thread, workflow reference, and next capability now agree on fraction equivalence.

slices.title: Fraction-equivalence-authority
slices.summary: Fraction equivalence now has branded semantic authority with exact source/target identities, ordered correspondences, one shared factor copied into both branches, and required denominator/factor nonzero evidence; no CAS or presentation policy was introduced.

slices.title: Fraction-equivalence-registration
slices.summary: Fraction-equivalence semantics now enter compilation through one planner-exposed governed operation with authenticated source binding, exact roles, nonzero evidence, correspondence identity, and endpoint validation.

slices.summary: Fraction equivalence now compiles into a branded, renderer-neutral presentation plan that keeps native fraction structure stable, persists numerator and denominator identity, copies one factor into two synchronized branches, and defers timing, geometry, and paint to the exemplar.
